children: Canada asset manager's fiscal Q3 adjusted EPS missed analyst expectations
Total assets under management and fee-earning assets rose 31% yr/yr
Free cash flow increased 27% yr/yr, driven by higher net management fees
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current or future periods
HIGHER NET MANAGEMENT FEES - Co attributed increased free cash flow to higher net management, advisory and administration fees
EXPANDED ETF AND SMA OFFERINGS - Co said launch of new ETF series units and expanded SMA access broadened reach and met demand for flexible investment solutions
HIGHER NON-COMPENSATION EXPENSES - Adjusted selling, general and administrative costs increased due to higher non-compensation expenses
